python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cursor = conn.cursor()
for table in ['geography', 'operating_metrics', 'revenues']:
    cursor.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({table})')
    print(f'\n=== {table} ===')
    for col in cursor.fetchall():
        print(col)
    cursor.execute(f'SELECT * FROM {table}')
    for row in cursor.fetchall():
        print(row)
"

python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# yield_2024
sql24 = \"\"\"SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Transaction revenues' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.metric='Total payment volume' THEN o.amount ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end=o.period_end AND r.months=o.months WHERE r.period_end='2024-12-31' AND o.period_end='2024-12-31'\"\"\"
cursor.execute(sql24)
r = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f'yields_2024 SQL: {r}')

# yield_2023
sql23 = \"\"\"SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Transaction revenues' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.metric='Total payment volume' THEN o.amount ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end=o.period_end AND r.months=o.months WHERE r.period_end='2023-12-31' AND o.period_end='2023-12-31'\"\"\"
cursor.execute(sql23)
r = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f'yield_2023 SQL: {r}')

# yield_change
sqlch = \"\"\"SELECT (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Transaction revenues' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS REAL)/SUM(CASE WHEN o.metric='Total payment volume' THEN o.amount ELSE 0.0 END)*100.0 FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end=o.period_end AND r.months=o.months WHERE r.period_end='2024-12-31' AND o.period_end='2024-12-31') - (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Transaction revenues' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS REAL)/SUM(CASE WHEN o.metric='Total payment volume' THEN o.amount ELSE 0.0 END)*100.0 FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end=o.period_end AND r.months=o.months WHERE r.period_end='2023-12-31' AND o.period_end='2023-12-31') * 100.0\"\"\"
cursor.execute(sqlch)
r = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f'yield_change SQL: {r}')

# transaction_contribution
sqltc = \"\"\"SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Transaction revenues' AND r.period_end='2024-12-31' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Transaction revenues' AND r.period_end='2023-12-31' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END)) / (SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Total net revenues (2)' AND r.period_end='2024-12-31' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.category='Total net revenues (2)' AND r.period_end='2023-12-31' THEN r.amount ELSE 0.0 END)) * 100.0 FROM revenues r\"\"\"
cursor.execute(sqltc)
r = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f'transaction_contribution SQL: {r}')
"

python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cursor = conn.cursor()

queries = [
    ('yield_2024', \"\"\"SELECT (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Transaction revenues' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) / (SELECT amount FROM operating_metrics WHERE metric='Total payment volume' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) * 100.0\"\"\"),
    ('yield_2023', \"\"\"SELECT (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Transaction revenues' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12) / (SELECT amount FROM operating_metrics WHERE metric='Total payment volume' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12) * 100.0\"\"\"),
    ('yield_change', \"\"\"SELECT ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Transaction revenues' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) / (SELECT amount FROM operating_metrics WHERE metric='Total payment volume' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) - (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Transaction revenues' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12) / (SELECT amount FROM operating_metrics WHERE metric='Total payment volume' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12)) * 100.0\"\"\"),
    ('transaction_contribution', \"\"\"SELECT ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Transaction revenues' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) - (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Transaction revenues' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12)) / ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Total net revenues (2)' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) - (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Total net revenues (2)' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12)) * 100.0\"\"\")
]
for name, sql in queries:
    cursor.execute(sql)
    r = cursor.fetchone()[0]
    print(f'{name}: {r}')
"
